messages:
customer-support: FYI support ticket #8472 — tenant 'acme-fin' reporting that archived audit logs fail to decrypt after last night's key rotation. error from our downloader: `InvalidCiphertextException` and `AccessDenied` on KMS decrypt. They need urgent access for compliance audit

alex: noted. can you paste the error lines and the request id from the API call? also which key arn was rotated?

customer-support: log snippet from the client's retrieval job: `2026-03-17T03:12:10Z ERROR decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: Ciphertext not valid for this key (status=400) request_id=rn-0a3b5c` they included the CMK alias: `alias/reports-acme-v2` and claim rotation window was 03:00 UTC.

maria: did we do a multi-step rotation (create new key, re-encrypt, swap alias) or alias swap only?

kms-bot: rotation job triggered: createKey -> schedulePendingWindow -> rotateAlias (alias/reports-acme-v2 -> arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:key/abcd-ef01) -> completed at 2026-03-17T03:02:12Z (job id rot-1122)

sam: quick question — are objects in S3 encrypted with SSE-KMS using the CMK alias, or client-side encrypted and then stored? if SSE-KMS, S3 should include EncryptionContext with `aws:s3:arn` etc. encryption context mismatch is common.

customer-support: they confirmed SSE-KMS via our UI. Their S3 put logs show header `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id: arn:aws:kms:.../reports-acme-old` and put event included context `{"tenant_id":"acme-fin","env":"prod"}`

ji-park: pinging infra. Does our downloader include the original encryption context when calling KMS decrypt? If the alias swapped to new key but objects still encrypted under old CMK, decrypt should still work if we pass the same encryption context and call decrypt on the right key. Error suggests either wrong context or request routed to the wrong key (cross-account/grant missing)

maria: I pulled the downloader code. We call KMS decrypt without explicitly providing EncryptionContext (we rely on KMS to match by ciphertext metadata). that can fail when client libraries drop context meta. here's the code: ```python
resp = kms_client.decrypt(CiphertextBlob=blob)
```
No EncryptionContext param.

alex: oof. but why would it have worked before rotation? maybe ciphertext included key id mapping and KMS routed to old key; after alias swap, alias points to new key and KMS routing changed. If encryption context isn't passed and multiple keys could decrypt, KMS will check metadata. rotation may have invalidated something.

sre-oncall: also check if the archived objects were re-encrypted with the new key after rotation. we do an on-access rewrap job for recent objects but not full backfill. older objects still under old key. If alias now points to new key, and the decrypt call doesn't specify KeyId, KMS might try alias -> new key which won't match ciphertext.

customer-support: client says they haven't re-encrypted archives. they just rely on alias semantics.

ji-park: action items: 1) reproduce locally with a sample archived blob (ask client for small sample or get from our debug store). 2) try explicit decrypt with KeyId set to old key arn and pass EncryptionContext they used. 3) if that works, we can add temporary codepath to prefer the previous key for that tenant while we rollout fix.

maria: I can repro using their sample blob (they uploaded to debug bucket). command I ran: ```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:key/oldkey-1234 --encryption-context '{"tenant_id":"acme-fin","env":"prod"}' --region eu-west-1
```
that returned plaintext succesfully. running same without `--encryption-context` returns InvalidCiphertextException. running with key-id set to the alias `alias/reports-acme-v2` (now pointing to new key) also fails.

alex: confirms encryption context mismatch — so root cause: our downloader not supplying encryption context + alias swap changed which key KMS tries by default.

customer-support: customer needs immediate access to those logs for audit in ~6 hours. what's the mitigation?

maria: short term: add a tenant-specific override in the downloader: if decrypt fails and tenant has recent rotation, try known previous key arns and re-attempt decrypt with the original encryption context. I'll prepare a patch and deploy as hotfix.

sam: also create a temporary runbook for support: how to run aws kms decrypt with the old key and context so they can fetch manually. include sample aws cli command and note that this requires kms:Decrypt permission on the old CMK.

ji-park: long term: change our object metadata and downloader to always record and pass the original EncryptionContext when calling KMS.decrypt, and update rotation playbook to ensure alias swap doesn't break on-access decrypts (either rewrap or update clients). Also add an automated backfill job for recent 90d archives.

kms-bot: key policy check: old key arn/oldkey-1234 has a Grant allowing service principal `s3.amazonaws.com` and our account root, but there is no explicit principal for `role/downloader` — rely on `kms:ViaService` from S3. confirm if downloader calls KMS directly, it needs explicit decrypt perms or a grant token.

alex: good catch. we might need a short-lived grant to allow downloader role decrypt access to old key until we finish backfill. who can create grants?

maria: I can create a grant via AWS CLI: ```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:key/oldkey-1234 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/downloader --operations Decrypt
``` I'll add `--retiring-principal` to let us retire later.

customer-support: can you also document the exact steps we should give the client if they prefer to run it themselves?

sam: I'll draft runbook snippet and post to #help after we patch. include these commands, permission checks, and a note about encryption context JSON formatting.

ji-park: assign follow-ups: maria to push hotfix to downloader (prefer old key if decrypt fails) and create grant; sam to publish runbook and coordinate with support; alex to track with compliance and confirm audit timeline. escalate to PM if needed.

customer-support: thanks — letting client know we have a mitigation plan and ETA 2h for temporary grant + runbook. they appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

maria: deploying hotfix to canary now, will monitor. logs show fallback decrypt path succeeded for sample: `decrypt success key=oldkey-1234 tenant=acme-fin`

sre-oncall: monitor KMS decrypt error rate spike for `InvalidCiphertextException` across tenants and rollback if we see any adverse effects.

alex: once hotfix validated, we'll schedule a postmortem and update rotation docs to require rewrap/backfill or metadata recording.

kms-bot: audit note: created grant gr-778899 for role/download (expires on manual retire). rotation job rot-1122 marked 'investigate' in changelog.

customer-support: closing loop with client now, will reopen if anything else crops up. thanks team!
